title: Hard to operate initially
text: Hard to operate initially. I wanted to make healthier salads with chopped veggies : carrots, broccoli, etc. This worked OK for the broccoli but wouldn't cut a single coin of carrot/radish into smaller 'bite' size pieces. I trashed it and went with a 'mini' electric powered food processor to get the job done. very disappointed with this.

product_metadata.title: Manual Food Processor Vegetable Chopper 2.3 Cup Small Mini Hand Pull String Onion Chopper Garlic Mincer Cutter with 3 Stainless Steel Blades - White
features: 🥦Why do we recommend this manual food chopper? Because it can really save you a lot of food preparing time and labor. In just 15s, you can get your chopped garlic and it won't smell like garlic all over the house. And you won't have to cry in chopping Onions. In addition, you can control the size of ingredients at any time. If you want to get the coarse diced food, you can pull the string a little bit less. If you want the ingredients finely chopped, you can do it a couple of times.

🥦Super Quick Chopping Vegetables: Why can our manual processor process food so quickly? All thanks to our sharp blades. The curved blade edge increases the contact area between the food and the blade, and the three blades are distributed in different directions and heights, so that all the ingredients can be fully chopped. When you pull the string, the blade acts like a fan, making rapid contact with the ingredients, so as to achieve the purpose of fast grinding.

🥦This small pull chopper will really help you in the kitchen: It doesn't just quickly process garlic and Onions, it can process a lot of other ingredients, ideal for avocado, ginger, tomato, potato, celery, chili, chicken, fish, shrimp, cabbage, carrot, coriander, herb, radish, sweet potato, cauliflower, pepper, nuts, mushroom, cucumber, watermelon, boneless and skinless meat and so on! You can cook a lot of delicious food with ease, such as salad, salsa, pesto, hummus, guacamole and so on!

🥦There are many advantages with our garlic chopper: It runs without electrical, no technology to set up, is super simple to use and clean and, best of all, is less noisy than an electric processor. Compared with traditional knives, our onion chopper does not need to touch the blade during use, which is safer. It will also make your countertop cleaner. Because of its small size, it is also suitable to chop small amounts of ingredients. In addition, it is also very convenient to carry out.

🥦Safe & Durable Material: The bowl is made from thickened BPA free plastic that has been passed the falling test. The durable nylon string withstand thousands of times pull. The design of handle is according to human engineering mechanics, perfect joint your palm. The sharp blades are made from 420 stainless steel and is won’t blunt, bent and rust. 🥦After-Sales Service: Every pull chopper is backed with 365-day warranty.
